description:
**Every verified program for the 1,000 scored puzzles of Santa 2026 - The Elf Calculator, with its source, plus the data and tools behind our analysis notebook.** Updated in place: one documented change per version (see `history.csv`).

Analysis notebook: https://www.kaggle.com/code/asteriospanoras/santa-2026-where-instructions-go-what-fails

## Files
- `puzzles.csv`, `practice_puzzles.csv` - the official competition data, included unchanged so a notebook needs only this dataset (competition rules: data access and use Open Source).
- `best_programs.csv` - `id`, `instructions`, `source`, `program` (JSON list of `[op, i, j, d]`). Every program replays correctly under the competition rules; total 141,339 in version 1. To submit, write `id,program` with a CSV writer.
- `experiments.csv` - twelve ideas we tested on the best public programs: how, how many puzzles, the result and why it failed.
- `headroom_independent_build.csv` - cost of building each remaining target on its own vs the published programs (20 puzzles).
- `practice_structure_costs.csv` - for every practice target, the exact cost (<= 4) from the starting values plus the smaller targets.
- `public_lineage.csv` - the public scores of day one, each recomputed from the notebook output.
- `history.csv` - one line per version.
- `elf_tools/` - our exact verifier, DAG-aware exact searches (depth 4 and 5), cone re-synthesis, joint-cut and suffix passes, and an extended suffix rebuilder in C++.

## Sources and license
The programs are public work released under the Apache License 2.0, re-verified here; `source` names the origin of each one:
Tony Li (Elf Calculator With Register Reuse), konbu17 (Wider Dictionary + Portfolio and its dataset), Elias T.-H. Shieh (Verified Best Programs and dataset), Mizero Lucky Gall and thisray (credited in those datasets), Nilanjan_Saha123 (Best-of-Public Elf Optimizer), Atakan Aldemir (Joint Recipes for Large Puzzles), Angel Jacinto Sanchez Ruiz (Public Merge) and Sargis Khachatryan (Cross-Trace MILP). `elf_tools/elf_suffix_ext.cpp` is based on Nilanjan_Saha123's suffix rebuilder. This dataset is released under the Apache License 2.0.
